title: Inter don't need Lautaro for Como — Jones and Stones are back
caption: Inter go into Como without their captain. Curtis Jones and John Stones return to full group work and should be in Sunday's squad, per Gazzetta dello Sport; Lautaro Martinez's left thigh is the squad's most stubborn problem and the target is Atalanta away on Nov 22. Inter won 0-3 at Feyenoord on Tuesday — Bisseck, Esposito, Zielinski — with Pavard back on in the 85th. #Inter #InterComo #Lautaro https://www.nerazzurridaily.com/go/tt/?ed=65
